manuscript_wording: A frozen ordinary-drug prior shows a reproducible positive association with continuous MDR1-MDCK efflux risk.
supporting_evidence: Biogen identity-clean rho=0.247 CI 0.207-0.284; ASAP rho=0.550 CI 0.208-0.744
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not call this accurate substrate truth or causal transport attribution.

manuscript_wording: Uncertainty-aware abstention improves reliability at the cost of coverage.
supporting_evidence: Biogen binary baseline BAcc=0.582/MCC=0.168 at 100% coverage versus selective BAcc=0.735/MCC=0.499 at 17.3% coverage
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Always report coverage and class-specific accepted counts.

manuscript_wording: The improvement persists after exact identity and reference-Murcko-scaffold exclusion.
supporting_evidence: Scaffold-clean selective n=439; BAcc=0.723; MCC=0.479; continuous rho=0.242 CI 0.205-0.281
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not equate scaffold-clean with prospective source independence.

manuscript_wording: Forced decisions among rows rejected by the selective system are substantially less reliable.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not hide this layer when presenting a full-coverage binary interface.

manuscript_wording: Abstention is explainable through probability gray zones, domain limits, bootstrap instability, and model/neighborhood conflicts.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Abstention is a decision policy, not a biological third class.

manuscript_wording: Nominally large public binary data can become unsuitable for external validation after provenance and identity cleaning.
supporting_evidence: Daood 607 rows -> 156 identity-clean rows with only 4 positives
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not report Daood clean ROC-AUC without the four-positive denominator.

manuscript_wording: The selective gain is not explained by probability extremeness alone and is driven mainly by supported cross-model directional agreement.
supporting_evidence: Margin-only BAcc=0.642; full v0.4 BAcc=0.735; without model agreement BAcc=0.634
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: This is a post-hoc external rule decomposition, not a newly tuned operating policy.

manuscript_wording: The frozen output is an external risk-ranking score rather than an absolute substrate probability.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not translate a score of 0.70 into a 70% probability of substrate truth.

manuscript_wording: The local-neighborhood guard did not improve this external benchmark and should be re-tested in a future frozen model revision.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not call the post-hoc without-local variant externally validated.

manuscript_wording: The direct-experiment reference channel contributes non-redundant selective information beyond the 443-row weak-label reference channel.
supporting_evidence: Full versus primary-channel-only BAcc difference=0.057, 95% CI 0.019-0.093; direct-complete BAcc=0.750
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Channel variants have different coverage and accepted sets; describe as post-hoc decomposition, not a causal or prospectively validated model comparison.

manuscript_wording: The direct-channel local-neighborhood guard accounts for most of the local-rule performance loss in this benchmark.
supporting_evidence: Direct-support no-local BAcc=0.775; direct-channel complete BAcc=0.750; full v0.4 BAcc=0.735
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: This identifies a future rule-revision hypothesis only; do not replace v0.4 using the same external outcome.

manuscript_wording: The frozen raw output is significantly miscalibrated in the Biogen MDR1-MDCK system.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Call the output a risk score, not an absolute universal substrate probability.

manuscript_wording: A simple Platt mapping can correct probability scale within the same Biogen source without improving discrimination.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: This is same-source group-cross-fitting, not an independently validated calibrator and not a replacement for v0.4.

manuscript_wording: Forced-binary error is dominated by false positives and concentrated in the score interval immediately above 0.5.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Do not tune a new threshold on this same outcome; use the finding to justify abstention and future frozen validation.

manuscript_wording: The framework can triage standardized free or ADC-released small-molecule structures.
supporting_evidence: v0.4 ADC release-species demonstration and context guards
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Application demonstration is not ADC-specific accuracy validation.

manuscript_wording: This is a universal assay-independent ABCB1 substrate classifier.
supporting_evidence: No qualifying matched-parental/inhibitor-rescue future source with balanced positives and negatives
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Replace with selective ABCB1 efflux-risk screening framework.

manuscript_wording: The study validates intact-ADC efflux, intracellular unbound exposure, resistance, efficacy, or clinical DDI.
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Keep ADC as an implications/application section only.

manuscript_wording: Abstain is a third biological class.
supporting_evidence: v0.4 protocol defines abstention as insufficient/conflicting/out-of-domain evidence
mandatory_boundary_or_replacement: Use high risk, low risk, or abstain decision outputs; two biological classes only when discussing the weak baseline.
